mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document_chunks c USING documents d WHERE c.document_id = d.id AND d.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_chunks (id, document_id, version_id, chunk_index, content, heading, line_start, line_end, embedding_dimensions, embedding) VALUES (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{versionId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{heading}, #{lineStart}, #{lineEnd}, #{embeddingDimensions}, CAST(#{vector} AS vector))
